Study & controls

Actual Blender armature clips on the new batch-two models. Rigid articulation preserves the crafted silhouettes; these are animation studies, pending asset review and registration before game use.

Walk and idles loop. Attack, defend, celebrate and perish play once and hold. Rest loops in a crouched breathing pose. Walk stays in place.

Drag to orbit. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Shift-scroll, Shift-drag or right-drag to pan. Middle-drag orbits. Two fingers dolly/pan. Fit resets the view.
